title: finding(ci,console): the console eager-closure ceiling has ~0.1 KB left (3104.4 of 3104.5 KB on PR objectui#10986's run); the next eager byte on any PR fails Bundle Analysis in the merge queue
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) from its PR stream. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's. The gate script lives under `scripts/`, so the seat does not edit it.

## Measured (the `Console Performance Budget` comments the gate posts)

| PR, run | Eager closure (gzip) | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| objectui#10953 | 3103.3 KB, then 3103.2 KB | 3104.5 KB |
| objectui#10957 | 3103.2 KB | 3104.5 KB |
| objectui#10983 and #10985 | 3103.9 KB | 3104.5 KB |
| objectui#10986, latest run on its repair head | **3104.4 KB** | 3104.5 KB |

The ceiling is `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES = 3_179_000` in `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`. Its own docblock says it is built as the `BASELINE` measurement (commit `bbf6b02d9`) plus half of `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES` (about 45 KB of headroom). The live closure has drifted up by roughly that whole amount since the baseline was pinned, so the growth room the design intends is spent.
- Each of the PRs above added little or nothing eager on its own. The reviews of objectui#10953 and #10986 measured their own deltas at a few hundred bytes or zero. The drift is `main`'s accumulated growth.
- **Consequence.** The next PR on any lane that adds an eager byte fails the required `Bundle Analysis` at PR time, or later in the merge queue once its queue commit sits on a `main` that has grown past it. That will read as an unrelated red, the way the Spec gate red did earlier today.

## The two remedies the script itself documents
1. **Re-pin.** Take a fresh absolute reading, re-pin `BASELINE` to it, and move `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` to that reading plus half the regression size, in one commit. The script's re-pin entries and its live headroom check describe how, and its unit test pins the invariant.
2. **Shrink.** Take bytes off the eager path; the objectui#9399 lucide precedent is an example.

⛔ Not a remedy: raising the ceiling alone past the regression size. The docblock names that as the way a budget gets switched off rather than fixed.

Which remedy, and when, is triage's routing call and the owning lane's to execute. The seat flags only the timing: the room is effectively zero now.

Dedupe words: eager closure headroom exhausted, MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES re-pin, Console Performance Budget 3104.4, Bundle Analysis budget drift.
